# mewa_ui

mewa_ui is a framework-free UI library for semantic HTML, tokenized CSS, local SVG icons, and small native-first ES modules.

Use this file as a routing index.

## Read order

1. Read `library/DESIGN.md`.
2. Read `library/system/foundations.md`.
3. Read `library/system/components.md`.
4. Read the matching `library/components/{slug}/{slug}.md`.
5. Read `library/system/patterns.md` for page composition.
6. Read `library/system/layouts.md` for shell composition.
7. Read `library/system/accessibility.md` for interaction acceptance.
8. Read `registry.json` for asset and selection metadata.

## Source of truth

`library/src/base.css` defines fonts, palette primitives, typography, spacing, sizes, borders, reset rules, and browser foundations.

`library/src/tokens.css` defines semantic light and dark theme roles.

`registry.json` defines component selection, dependency, asset, and token metadata.

`library/components/{slug}/{slug}.md` defines component-specific markup and behavior.

`library/components/{slug}/{slug}.css` defines component presentation.

`library/components/{slug}/{slug}.js` defines required or optional component enhancement.

`docs/{slug}.html` demonstrates the component.

`library/system/` defines selection, patterns, shells, and accessibility rules.

## Absolute rules

Use semantic HTML first.

Use links for navigation.

Use buttons for actions.

Use native form controls when they meet the task.

Load `library/src/base.css` before `library/src/tokens.css`.

Load only the component assets listed in `registry.json`.

Use only documented classes and `data-*` attributes.

Use semantic color roles.

Use square geometry.

Use borders instead of shadows.

Use blur only on top-level sticky shell chrome.

Keep the main canvas continuous.

Do not place a card inside another card.

Do not wrap a table in a card.

Keep state changes immediate.

Spinner rotation is the only animation exception.

Use local icons from `library/src/icons/`.

Inline the SVG for the no-JavaScript path.

Keep every control named and keyboard operable.

Keep every status understandable without color.

Support increased contrast and forced colors.

Keep the documented native fallback.

## Selection

Use `library/system/components.md` to choose among all 80 components.

Use `Table` for structural tabular data.

Use `Data Table` for documented filtering, sorting, result status, and pagination around Table.

Use `Date Field` for a native browser date control.

Use `Date Picker` for a custom month grid.

Use `Select` for a short fixed option list.

Use `Combobox` for a searchable option list.

Use `Checkbox` for a submitted independent choice.

Use `Switch` for an immediate binary system state.

Use `Card` only for one independent object or small content group.

Use App Shell for reusable application chrome and page regions.

Use Sidebar for collapsible application navigation.

Use a pattern before you create a new component.

## JavaScript modes

`requiresJs: true` means the documented interactive component requires its module.

`enhancementJs: true` means native markup works without the module.

`jsMode: "none"` means the component has no component runtime.

Keep modules idempotent.

Keep modules safe for markup inserted after navigation.

Keep modules safe to import without a browser DOM.

Use packaged controllers with an application lifecycle.

Use packaged automatic enhancers for plain HTML.

Do not add a core runtime dependency.

## Shells

mewa_ui does not ship complete shell templates.

Use the sidebar shell for persistent application navigation.

Use the top-navigation shell for a small flat route set.

Use the focused-tool shell for one primary task.

Use a 90rem canvas for dense application pages.

Use a 64rem canvas for focused tools.

Use `60rem` for wide content-and-rail collapse.

Use `48rem` for shell navigation changes.

Use `37.5rem` for compact single-column changes.

## Validation

Run `node --run test`.

Run `node --run catalog:check`.

Run `node --run package:check`.

Run `node --run test:browser` after installing the locked browser-test dependency when Chromium is available.

Check changed markup with the keyboard.

Check changed markup at 200 percent zoom.

Check changed markup at 320px width.

Check the no-JavaScript path.

Reject undocumented APIs.
